input.sql:
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE workspace.exam_x59ed7.dq_report AS
SELECT 'null_amount' AS check_name, COUNT(*) AS failing_rows FROM workspace.exam_x59ed7.dq_orders WHERE amount IS NULL
UNION ALL
SELECT 'negative_amount', COUNT(*) FROM workspace.exam_x59ed7.dq_orders WHERE amount < 0
UNION ALL
SELECT 'duplicate_order_id', (COUNT(*) - COUNT(DISTINCT order_id)) FROM workspace.exam_x59ed7.dq_orders
UNION ALL
SELECT 'orphan_customer', COUNT(*) FROM workspace.exam_x59ed7.dq_orders o LEFT JOIN workspace.exam_x59ed7.dq_customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE c.customer_id IS NULL
UNION ALL
SELECT 'future_order_date', COUNT(*) FROM workspace.exam_x59ed7.dq_orders WHERE order_date > DATE('2026-11-01')
UNION ALL
SELECT 'invalid_status', COUNT(*) FROM workspace.exam_x59ed7.dq_orders WHERE status NOT IN ('new','paid','shipped','cancelled');
SELECT check_name, failing_rows FROM workspace.exam_x59ed7.dq_report ORDER BY failing_rows DESC LIMIT 1;
